items.headline: $NEAR explodes 80% in a week as Intents volume nears $30B
items.summary: $NEAR is on a tear, rallying nearly 80% in seven days as its Intents liquidity layer approaches $30B in volume. One of the strongest large-mid cap moves this week.

items.headline: New launch: Paimon Finance debuts $pPOLY with PancakeSwap
items.summary: Paimon Finance just launched its $pPOLY project in partnership with PancakeSwap, bringing a fresh token to the BNB Chain DEX ecosystem. Early-stage launch worth watching.

items.headline: $INJ Meridian upgrade vote targets Sept 24 mainnet
items.summary: Injective's Meridian upgrade vote is live, targeting mainnet activation on September 24. A major protocol milestone that could catalyze $INJ momentum this week.

items.headline: $STONK hits new highs after erasing 27% crash
items.summary: $STONK fully recovered from a brutal 27% drop and ripped to fresh all-time highs. The hot surging token is drawing speculative attention from momentum traders.

items.headline: $UNI v4 leads DeFi in tokenized stock deposits
items.summary: Uniswap v4 now tops all DeFi protocols in tokenized stock deposit volume, riding the SEC's new exemption for onchain equities. A fresh DeFi use case gaining traction for $UNI.
